extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with common difference d; nth term a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with common ratio r; nth term a_n = a_1 r^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite geometric series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: S_infinity = a_1/(1-r) when |r| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponent laws
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules such as a^m a^n = a^(m+n) and (a^m)^n = a^(mn).

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: log_a(x) = y if and only if a^y = x.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of base formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: log_a(x) = log_b(x)/log_b(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number z = a + bi where i^2 = -1.

extracted_concepts.name: Modulus of complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) for z = a + bi.

extracted_concepts.name: Argument of complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: arg(z) = arctan(b/a) for z = a + bi.

extracted_concepts.name: Polar form of complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: z = r(cos theta + i sin theta).

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relation with domain, range, intercepts, and symmetry.

extracted_concepts.name: Function transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Translations, reflections, and stretches of function graphs.

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c.

extracted_concepts.name: Vertex of quadratic function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vertex x-coordinate x = -b/(2a).

extracted_concepts.name: Discriminant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Delta = b^2 - 4ac for ax^2 + bx + c.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x) = P(x)/Q(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Vertical asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Occurs where Q(x) = 0 in a rational function.

extracted_concepts.name: Horizontal asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Determined by degree comparison in rational functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x) = a^x; includes natural exponential f(x) = e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: g(x) = log_a(x); includes natural logarithm ln(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Natural logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Logarithm with base e: g(x) = ln(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Radian measure
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure used in circle geometry formulas.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc length formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: s = r theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Sector area formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A = 1/2 r^2 theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions such as sin x, cos x, and tan x.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean trigonometric identity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: sin^2 x + cos^2 x = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Double angle formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Object with magnitude and direction in 2D or 3D.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a · b = |a||b| cos theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Cross product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: |a × b| = |a||b| sin theta in 3D.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Foundation for continuity and differentiability.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding derivatives using rules or first principles.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Indefinite and definite integration, including substitution and parts.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Study of sample spaces, events, and likelihood.

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given another event.

extracted_concepts.name: Bayes' theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relates conditional probabilities.

extracted_concepts.name: Normal distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous probability distribution with expected value and variance.
